name: Timeworn
source:
Timeworn is a shifting perspective, linear visual novel with furry characters. It follows the meandering adventures of four close friends. Their journeys will lead them to fetchingly fantastic and fiercely fetid places, times, and people. 

Our four have come into adulthood and cope with their struggles, as all new adults do. Chiefly among them- their kind’s dwindling access to magic.

They are Gaians, part of a society of people that seek to live harmoniously with the Earth following the long-past collapse of human civilization. While they prefer magic to solve most of their problems, human technology is not entirely foreign to them.

If you decide to hear their tale, you’ll encounter the magical power of friendship, queer romance, communal healing, self-discovery, and just a dash of horny.

I hope you laugh.

I hope you’ll be moved.

I hope you don’t think I’m guilting you into recycling.

But most of all, I hope you realize or remember that you can get through anything with supportive people beside you.

Never stop looking for those people, or loving them if you've already found them.

[From [url=https://ardenlawless.itch.io/timeworn]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Timeworn》是一部视角不断变化、带有毛茸茸角色的线性视觉小说。它讲述了四个亲密朋友的曲折冒险。他们的旅程将带领他们前往迷人奇幻而又极其恶臭的地方、时间和人物。

我们的四个人已经成年并应对他们的斗争，就像所有新成年人一样。其中最主要的是——他们的种族获得魔法的机会越来越少。

他们是盖亚人，是人类文明崩溃后寻求与地球和谐相处的社会的一部分。虽然他们更喜欢用魔法来解决大部分问题，但人类技术对他们来说并不完全陌生。

如果你决定听听他们的故事，你会遇到友谊、酷儿浪漫、集体治愈、自我发现和一点点饥渴的神奇力量。

我希望你笑。

我希望你会被感动。

我希望你不要认为我回收垃圾让你感到内疚。

但最重要的是，我希望你意识到或记住，有支持你的人在身边，你可以度过任何难关。

永远不要停止寻找那些人，或者如果你已经找到了他们，就不要停止爱他们。

[来自[url=https://ardenlawless.itch.io/timeworn]Itch.io[/url]]
